files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
First public release.

- Frame-accurate client review with its own review token, drawings, ranges and replies.
- Versions, approval, read-only archive with configurable retention and deletion log.
- Project folders and "Send for review" in the Files app.
- Export as EDL, FCP7 XML and CSV; Premiere Pro panel.
- Admin settings for groups, link lifetime, retention, embedding and the language of project subfolders.
- English and German (informal and formal); the Premiere Pro panel can be switched between English and German.
